children: CrossAmerica Partners LP reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.195 billion, up 22.9% from the prior-year quarter, while net income fell 35.5% to $8.8 million and diluted EPS declined to $0.21 from $0.34.
Revenue was $1.195B, compared with $971.8M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 22.9%.
Net income was $8.8M, compared with $13.6M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (35.5%).
Diluted EPS was $0.21, compared with $0.34 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (38.2%).
Nine-month revenue rose 15% to $3.22 billion, primarily as average fuel selling prices increased 29%, despite a 9% decline in fuel volumes.

Nine-month retail gross profit increased 9%, reflecting higher fuel margins and merchandise profitability. Wholesale gross profit declined 4% as lower fuel volumes and fewer lessee sites offset higher fuel margins.

The partnership continued selling and converting sites, often retaining fuel supply through long-term contracts. Management expects further divestitures and site-class conversions; additional site sales could reduce segment gross profit while supporting lower interest costs. Acquisitions remain opportunistic.
